headline: 11 contracts catalogued from official docs across Base, Optimism and Avalanche; all are Loan, Vault or Portfolio Factory, with no admin/owner/multisig addresses yet and no on-chain verification.

findings.text: Block-explorer name-tag search was not performed. A direct basescan.org fetch and a defipunkd API fetch were both rejected by the tool allowlist, and the web searches surfaced no explorer pages. No explorer-tagged addresses were obtained.

The old GitBook page (40acres.gitbook.io .../smart-contracts) and the newer Mintlify page (docs.40acres.finance/security) both list Loan and Vault addresses for Base, Optimism and Avalanche. The Mintlify page also lists an Avalanche Portfolio Factory and splits Avalanche into Pharaoh and Blackhole deployments. The llms.txt index points to a dedicated /contracts page that was not fetched.
No audit PDF was opened. The GitBook page references Sherlock audits (website says '6× audited by Sherlock'; docs say four audits). No scope address tables were extracted.

The GitHub repo 40-Acres/loan-contracts was fetched at the landing-page level. It has an addresses/ directory, script/ deploy scripts and packages/contracts, but none were walked and no commit SHA was pinned. No addresses were extracted from the repo.
Addresses were catalogued for all three pinned chains (Base 2, Optimism 2, Avalanche 7) from docs only. None were verified on a chain explorer.

No factory enumeration was done. The Avalanche Portfolio Factory (0x52d4...) and the PortfolioManager/FacetRegistry architecture described in the README were not read via the API, because the surfacer allowlist rejected non-pinned addresses.
All addresses are tagged with the controlled-vocabulary role and actor_class 'unknown', since no bytecode or ABI was read. No owner, admin, timelock or multisig addresses were discovered.
Every admin_addresses entry traces to a fetched or search-returned docs page body in evidence[]. Conflicting Avalanche entries are flagged in unknowns.

rationale.verdict: Discovery slice, so grade is unknown. Website, docs, GitBook and the GitHub landing page were read and 11 docs-listed contract addresses were catalogued. Explorer, audit and repo-artifact walks were not completed, and no control or admin addresses were found.

evidence.shows: Website: live markets are Aero and Hydrex on Base, Pharaoh and Blackhole on Avalanche, and Velodrome on Optimism (closed to new loans). It also describes self-repaying, non-liquidatable USDC loans against veNFTs, links the docs at docs.40acres.finance, and says '6× audited by Sherlock'.

Legacy GitBook 'Deployed Addresses' page (fetched body). It has Loan/Vault tables for Base, Optimism and Avalanche, and the addresses appear in order: 0x87f18b37..., 0xB99B6dF9..., 0xf132bD88..., 0x08dCDBf7..., 0xf6a044c3..., 0xbeD7C028.... The role-to-address mapping is derived from table order, since the fetched text separates the tables from the addresses. A search snippet of the same URL shows Avalanche Vault as 0x124D00b1... instead of 0xbeD7C028..., so the page has differing versions.

Mintlify 'Audits & Security' page (search-returned body). It lists Deployed Contracts. Base: Loan 0x87f18b377e625b62c708D5f6EA96EC193558EFD0, Vault 0xB99B6dF96d4d5448cC0a5B3e0ef7896df9507Cf5. Optimism: Loan 0xf132bD888897254521D13e2c401e109caABa06A7, Vault 0x08dCDBf7baDe91Ccd42CB2a4EA8e5D199d285957. Avalanche (Pharaoh): Loan 0x6Bf2Fe80D245b06f6900848ec52544FBdE6c8d2C, Vault 0x124D00b1ce4453Ffc5a5F65cE83aF13A7709baC7, Portfolio Factory 0x52d43C377e498980135C8F2E858f120A18Ea96C2. Avalanche (Blackhole): Loan 0x5122f5154DF20E5F29df53E633cE1ac5b6623558, Vault 0xC0485C4bafB594Ae1457820fb6e5B67e8A04BCFD.

Docs home (fetched): supported ecosystems table (Base/Aerodrome, Optimism/Velodrome, Avalanche/Pharaoh and Blackhole). It states four Sherlock audits and says smart contracts are immutable and non-upgradeable post-deployment.

Docs index (fetched): lists pages including Contracts (https://docs.40acres.finance/contracts.md), Audits & Security, Treasury and Portfolio Accounts. It confirms a dedicated contracts page exists (not itself fetched).

Canonical source repo (fetched landing page): Foundry project with addresses/, script/, src/ and packages/contracts directories. The README describes PortfolioManager, PortfolioFactory + FacetRegistry and per-user diamond-proxy portfolio accounts. It links a Sherlock bug bounty (audits.sherlock.xyz/bug-bounties/102) and lists deploy scripts (BaseDeploy, NativeVaultDeploy, EntryPointDeploy, PharaohDeploy). No commit SHA was captured.

No on-chain state was read.

D2: the dedicated docs page https://docs.40acres.finance/contracts.md (listed in llms.txt as organized by category) was not fetched; it may list more addresses (e.g. PortfolioManager, FacetRegistry, relayers, treasury, Hydrex Base contracts, Blackhole/Pharaoh factories).

The GitBook page lists Loan 0xf6a044c3b2a3373ef2909e2474f3229f23279b5f and Vault 0xbeD7C02887EfD6b5Eb9A547Ac1A4D5e582791647 in the fetched body (the search snippet shows Vault 0x124D00b1...). D7: owner/admin/timelock/multisig/treasury/relayer/oracle addresses not discovered; the docs Treasury page (https://docs.40acres.finance/treasury.md) was not fetched.

protocol_metadata.about: 40 Acres is a cashflow lending protocol where users deposit vote-escrowed NFTs (e.g. veAERO, veVELO, vePHAR, veBLACK) as collateral and borrow USDC against the weekly rewards those assets earn. Loans are self-repaying: collateral rewards are applied to the debt each epoch, with a share going to USDC lenders (via a vault) and the protocol, and the docs say there are no liquidations. Lenders supply USDC to vaults and earn a share of those rewards.
